text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from its early value, but a sequence of losses alone does not show that selling is wise; I should reassess each holding’s fundamentals and risk rather than react to recent prices.","Selling Stock D after a very large loss may have been driven by the loss itself. I should base future sell decisions on its prospects and portfolio role, not on my average cost or a desire to avoid realizing a loss.","I have traded rarely, so I should make that restraint intentional: periodically review diversification, cash needs, and risk exposure, then trade only when the evidence or my goals justify it."]}
